concerns.text: SC-009 requires a linear regression on the top‑5 features identified by permutation importance/SHAP from the same Bi‑LSTM model and dataset, demanding R² ≥ 0.30 and p < 0.05. Because feature selection and performance evaluation are performed on the identical data, the validation is circular: the regression’s success is guaranteed by the prior selection bias, violating independence between predictor construction and validation target.

SC-008 mandates a Spearman ρ ≥ 0.7 between permutation‑importance and SHAP rankings as a ‘consistency check.’ Both rankings are derived from the same trained model, so the criterion measures internal agreement rather than an independent validation of interpretability; it is effectively tautological and does not substantiate the claim that the identified signatures are physically meaningful.
